Recomputed from ledgers on each call — these categories are NOT persisted (§7.1). The `income` array always includes every known income label (Airdrops, Income, Cashback, Interest, Mining, Reward, Royalties, Staking Rewards), with a zero/count:0 entry for any label the workspace has no matching transactions for.
